title: Mobile pass on the Nyborg app
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: The Nyborg app is easier on a phone: bigger taps on home, hatch, match setup, watch and the finish card, less scroll on hatch, and no sideways scroll on setup.
A leftover bug that printed the race engine's start() source as the Start button label is fixed; the label is now startLabel. Desktop layout and the sim are unchanged.
next: Share pack on the finish card (Race my Nyborg), after a look at this pass.
